email.subject: CoastAir's site can't take a call or a booking
email.body:
Ben,

I looked at CoastAir Group's site. Two things are likely costing you jobs: there's no click-to-call link, so anyone searching on a phone (most HVAC searches) has to manually dial instead of tapping once. And there's no booking option, so people who'd schedule a service at 9pm have no way to do it and just call the next company.

The page title is also weak and probably not pulling its weight in search results.

I fix these for local service businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening on your site?

Alex
